name: Dawnwalker Controller Tweaks
summary: Swap shoulders and triggers, enjoy a wider walking range, and use short press for Map or long press for Game Hub. No other mods or loaders required.
thumbnailAltText: Controller Tweaks and The Blood of Dawnwalker titles beside a black controller against an atmospheric dark castle backdrop.
fileDescription: Complete controller mod with shoulder/trigger swaps, a wider walking range, and short press Map / long press Game Hub. Install as Root (game folder) through Vortex. Original mod work is MIT-licensed. Runtime files are unchanged from 1.3.1.
